segments.say: This checkmate happens in only ten moves. Here's the trap.
segments.caption: The Siberian trap

segments.say: The Smith Morra Gambit. White gives two pawns for fast development.
segments.caption: Gambit opening

segments.say: Bishop c4. Queen c7. White castles. Knight f6. Queen e2.
segments.caption: Normal moves...

segments.say: Knight g4, eyeing h2. White kicks it with h3.
segments.caption: Kick the knight?

segments.say: But knight d4! Attacking the queen.
segments.caption: Knight d4!

segments.say: White takes the knight. And queen h2. Checkmate.
segments.caption: Queen h2 mate

segments.say: This is the Siberian trap. Save it if you play the Sicilian.
segments.caption: Save this trap
